entries.b7c3166951265f4e: For fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028, the company has formulated the “DMW Medium-Term Management Plan 2028” and sets as its long-term target state becoming a “solution leader” that meets global customer challenges with fluid machinery, drawing on its technological capabilities and the trust of its customers. The plan period is positioned as a phase for establishing the foundation to realize this, and the company will focus mainly on “strengthening earnings power in existing business areas” and “expanding new business areas” among its most important issues. In existing areas, it will advance strategic proposal sales of highly competitive products, such as the “AM-Turbo” multistage turbo blower with aluminum alloy impellers and the “Lambda 21” vertical shaft pump with a built-in speed reducer, and expand its P&M business for parts supply and maintenance. In new areas, it will expand sales of the “DeROs-E” energy recovery device for water treatment equipment, establish a planned production system, and build strategic partnerships and networks in overseas markets.
